balls.text: heaves this slower delivery across the line, gets an inside edge that flies wide of the stumps, Ishan can only half-stop and Dhoni squeezes in a second. What a finish.
make that three in a row! Hardik loses the plot, goes full searching for a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss and Dhoni simply flicks that over square leg. Tremendous bat speed
that's smacked over long-on!  Swatted powerfully and disdainfully. Hardik makes the cardinal sin of bowling length, Dhoni has a free swing across the line. Flat hit. Wow, just wow.
what a hit! That's an MS Dhoni special. Hardik feeds a sweet hit-me length to MS, still has to be hit alight and he clobbers this over long-off.
muscled to long-on where Nabi takes an excellent catch on the move. Mitchell stood off stump and tried to swing cleanly into the leg-side, struck it well but couldn't get the elevation.
spears it way outside off in anticipation of the batter moving around, another wide. Challenged once again, wonder why.
heaved down the ground and beats Nabi running around from long-on!

width outside off, Mitchell is beaten as he tries to cut and pick the gap at deep point. Wide signalled, Hardik reviews. Replays confiem it was well outside the marker with the batter making no attempt to move around the crease. The wide stands.
toe-ends this yorker on middle past Bumrah, a single is all they can get
can't get underneath the length again, squeezes the yorker to long-on
squeezed to long-on
the delicate reverse ramp to a full ball angling in towards the stumps, the ball plonks in between fine leg and the keeper running back
yorker honing in towards middle, squeezed past the bowler
full toss, hit hard to long-off
dug in short again, this time Dube manages to top-edge a pull over Ishan Kishan.
hit on the body as he swivels around to pick this over short fine. Cleverly dug into the pitch, targeting the rib-cage
squeezed down to long-on again
mistimes a heave down to long-on, a misfield allows them a chance to get the second
looks to flick him fine, deflects off the pad into the leg side
a dash of Yuvraj Singh in full flow! Low full toss on the pads and Dube flicks him imperiously into the gap at deep square leg.
clears his front leg and punches this full toss to long-off

belts this full toss through the gap between cover and mid-off. Opened the bat face just a touch to pick this gap. Bumrah went for another yorker and missed his length by very, very little, enough for Dube to take full toll.
into the blockhole, dug out to long-on again
superb yorker hining into the stumps, squeezed down to long-on as they scamper back for the second
squeezes this yorker-length delivery to long-on
cutter outside off, punched to sweeper cover
gloves the pull to short fine, one bounce to Bumrah. Two runs and a wicket off that over
pulled to deep midwicket
tucks him up with a hard-length delivery on the stumps, defended back
hard length into the pitch, defended back

mishit taken at long-on! Hardik bowls an off-cutter away from Gaikwad's hitting arc, he tries to fetch it and swing across the line but can't get any power behind that. End of a superb knock, a terrific partnership.
sliced over the infield to sweeper cover, Dube brings up a 28-ball fifty

scythed behind point! Makes room, takes it on the full and hits it into the gap as the bowler once again watches in astonishment at just how effortless Gaikwad made it look despite being cramped a touch

carved over deep point! Tremendous bat speed, tremendous power. He advanced down the track, Madhwal saw him coming and speared it wide, Gaikwad did well to not just reach it but also pick the bones out of it to clear Romario Shepherd
mistimes a lofted hit, plonks outside the circle at mid-on. David running in from long-on had no chance
rifled through the covers! Misses the yorker and gets pummeled past a diving Rohit
squeezes this yorker-length delivery to cover as they get across for a single
yorker-length but way outside off, jammed to deep point
scythes this low full toss through point! Incredible wrist work. Opened the bat face late to pick the gap as well
looks to hack that to deep square but misses, the ball deflects off the pad to point
bludgeoned! Short ball angled across, Dube fetches it from outside off and nails it off the middle. Deep midwicket had no chance.
goes fuller and the result is the same! Dube sets himself up to go straight and tees off like a golfer, clears long-on effortlessly. Incredible hitting.
clobbered enough to clear deep square leg. Short ball on middle and leg, proper fodder for Dube to swing it high and mighty.
mistimes a lofted hit to long-off
cramped for room as he angles this into the body, flicks something en route to Ishan. Was it the glove? Different matter that Ishan fumbled.
makes room and punches this full toss to mid-off
clean lofted hit down the ground, effortlessly clears long-off. Brings up a lovely 33-ball half-century

hustles Dube for pace with a skiddy delivery back in from around the stumps. Dube's feet off the ground as he's struck on the pad trying to whip it square. There was an appeal for lbw but not given. Surely going down leg.
yorker-length on off, dug out
squeezed out to the off side
heaved across the line and clears long-on! Fetched it from fifth-stump or thereabouts, not the cleanest of connections but just managed to get enough on it.
whipped to deep midwicket

dropped at deep midwicket by Rohit!  Gaikwad swung across the line, picked the bones out of it. Rohit did wonderfully well to get to the ball, he was on the move as the ball descended on him and it just didn't stick.
yorker-length outside off, looks to squeeze it down to third man but misses
yorker-length, dug out to cover
heaved away to deep midwicket where Romario puts in a swimming-pool like slide to stop the ball
helped up and over point and short third. Deliberate and very effective. Romario digs one short and wide at 125 clicks, that's recipe for punishment.
slower short of length ball outside off, slapped to sweeper cover
slips this down leg as he follows Gaikwad, it's helped along to short fine where Madhwal misfields. Tilak at deep square leg covers ground quickly
flat-batted to long-on
through with the pull even before the ball arrived, beaten.

starts with a short ball angling in from around the stumps, Dube frees his arms and slaps this through mid-off where Hardik throws himself full-stretch to try and pluck a one-handed stunner, but it just whizzed past him.
punched on the up to sweeper cover, Madhwal tumbles around to keep that to two.
punched down to long-on
freebie from Hardik.  Rang long hop down leg, Dube swivels around and helps it past short fine leg
thumped on the up to beat mid-off, skids away quickly off the turf and into the boundary. Valiant effort by Nabi in trying to pull it back in but ended up parrying the ball over
short of length and angling away, defended to point
dug in short, sits up for Dube as he spanks this through backward square leg. Imperious
flicks this low full toss to fine leg where Madhwal fumbles and allows them to pick a second.
slower length ball outside off, punched to point
sways out of the way of this short ball angled into the body
tucked off his hip to square leg
picks out this low full toss to cover, a misfield by Tim David  allows him to get off strike.  Turns out they didn't change strike.
stands tall and tucks this gently into the leg side
length ball on off, defended to cover
whipped to midwicket to get off the mark

shapes for a cut but misses. This skidded threw off the pitch. Wait, there is a stifled appeal from Ishan, but it's not given. Mumbai opt for a review. No one seems really concerned, but guess what? Ultra edge confirms there was a tiny spike.  Excellent review from Mumbai, credit to Ishan!  Hardik didn't seem entirely convinced but went upstairs reluctantly. And Rachin has to walk back.
muscled! This had to come at some point and Rachin's eyes lit up as Shreyas tossed it up. Even though it was away from his hitting arc, he swung through cleanly and cleared long-on effortlessly.
punched to sweeper cover, tight line around middle and off.
drifts in and gets it to dip on Gaikwad as he defends
short and slanted across, slapped to wide long-off
whips this down to long-on
works it down to long-on as he fetches it from outside off
punched to long-off
wrists this past midwicket
skids one through off a length on middle, Gaikwad tucks this to short fine
tossed up outside off. Gaikwad drives straight to cover
bunts it wide of point for a single
punched to point
picks it away past short fine! Madhwal drifts into middle and leg, Gaikwad uses the pace and angle to pick the gap there.
slaps this to deep point for a single
misfield at point by Shreyas Gopal!  Rachin scythes this away as he charges down the pitch, gets a lucky boundary.
spears in a super yorker on middle, dug out to mid-on from where there's a direct hit at the striker's end. Rachin is just in as he turns back after flirting with the idea of a single
chops it down to point
solidly defends this length ball on middle
this has been picked away off his hip to the square leg fence. Poor hit-me full toss that, and it's bread-and-butter for Gaikwad.
mistimes this heave to midwicket
this time it's much better, a lot more convincing!  Backs away again, Coetzee goes short on middle, Gaikwad uses the room to upper cut and beat third man.
makes room to access the off side, bowler follows him and Gaikwad gets a thick inside edge that runs away past short fine
that should give him oodles of confidence!  Lovely flick of the wrists to send this length ball on middle soaring through square leg.
beaten by the away movement this time! Rachin is struggling here. Bumrah is messing around with him with these subtle changes in length
hit on the pad as he attempts to flick this incoming delivery through midwicket
defended off the frontfoot to cover point. Can see the pressure building on Rachin. Release shot coming?
slips this full ball down leg from around the wicket. There was some noise as ball passed bat. May have been Rachin's bat flicking the pad as he tries to tickle it fine.
runs it down to third man
starts with hard length on the stumps, pushed to mid-on
slaps the cut straight to cover
drags this slog sweep to deep backward square leg

that's massive! Gaikwad is up and running with that muscular hit over long-on. Nabi went length. Gaikwad didn't get to the pitch but went flat-batted and connected it superbly as he got down on one knee.
works it away through midwicket for a single
punched uppishly down to deep midwicket
struck high on the body as he attempts an expansive sweep by getting outside the line. The ball deflected off the arm onto the helmet
off the edge, down to third man for a single
hops back and defends this short of length delivery into the off side

survived off the previous delivery, but doesn't off this one. Mistimes a pull straight to Hardik at mid-on and Wankhede belts out a roar like no other. Rahane was done in by Coetzee's pace, got it high on the bat as he tried to play in front of square. The move to promote him up the order hasn't worked for CSK tonight.

so nearly sneaked through! Rahane was looking to blast this down the ground, ended up getting a thick inside edge onto the pad. On another night, would've crashed into the stumps. Hands on heads for Coetzee
fuller and straighter on off, solidly defended
races away off a thickish inside edge past midwicket. Rachin was looking to drive on the up
full but slips it far too wide outside off for Rachin to even have a chance to get bat to it. Wide called
fired full and flat on off, Rahane's leading edge rolls to mid-off
swept up and over short fine! Rahane does well to get inside the line and pick it away
shortish, Rahane makes room and punches straight to cover point
skiddy delivery drifting into the pads, punched to wide mid-on
works it down to deep midwicket as CSK are away
tossed up outside off, driven straight to cover
inch-perfect off-stump yorker from Pathirana. 146.2ks. Rohit digs it out
another yorker, Nabi swings and squirts an inside edge behind to Dhoni
leg-side wide. Pathirana has to re-bowl it
Rohit shuffles across off and picks this full ball away over short fine leg. No chance for Rizvi in the deep

Hundred for Rohit! Full and outside off, 146.6ks, Rohit laces it through the line and puts it away to the left of long-off. He draws big cheers from the Wankhede crowd. But muted celebrations from Rohit himself. He didn't even raise his bat
scorching yorker from Pathirana. Nabi can't bring his bat down in time. MI scamper across for a bye
subtle slower ball outside off at 135ks, Nabi swings early and misses
muscled away over the wide long-on boundary. Slower cutter angling across off. Rohit shuffles across, gets inside the line and launches a six
another off-side wide from Mustafizur. Wonder if it's the dew
slogged away to Mitchell at long-on
slower cutter, full and wide of off, scythed away to the off-side sweeper
full and wide of off, driven to the right of long-off. Good defensive bowling once again from CSK
edged but falls short of Thakur at short third. Good effort from him, nevertheless. Very full and wide of off. Rohit throws his bat at ball and carves an outside edge
off-side wide from Mustafizur as he does not get the wide yorker right
short and into the pitch. Suspect it was the on-pace delivery from Mustafizur. Hauled away to Mitchell at long-on
yorker on off stump, driven down the ground for a double. What an effort from Pathirana. He still has one over left
shortish and outside off, Rohit aims to scoop it over short fine leg. No dice. He cops it on his body
yorker on the leg stump, glanced away to short fine leg

Nope. Pathirana knocks Shepherd over with a 149.3ks missile. Beaten for pace. Dhoni applauds him from behind the stumps. Not quite a yorker, very full and slings in, gathers pace off the pitch and knocks out the leg stump. Bam! What a sight for a fast bowler
pretty full on off, almost a yorker, which is swiped away to deep midwicket off the inner half
low full-toss on middle. It's a hard-to-hit full-toss. Clipped away through midwicket for a double
very full and wide of off. Rohit, having shuffled across off, drags this slowie away towards square leg, where Dube, I think, makes a sprawling save
placed to the left of Ravindra at long-off this time. Full-toss wide of off, Rohit latches onto it and pumps it over the off side for four
just short of a good length and slanting away outside off, chopped away to deep third

Some NZ love at the boundary. Ravindra takes it at long-off and gets a big hug from Mitchell. Another whippy cutter from Mustafizur, the line is wider. The line is right. David swings and holes out to long-off
Pumped over Mitchell at the long-on boundary. 120ks, another slower ball on off, Mustafizur can't get it wider. David loads up and wallops it over long-on
very full and pushed across off from left-arm over. Too wide. Left alone
starts off wit a slower offcutter outside off, David holds his shape for long enough and smites it straight of long-on for six
slower bouncer outside off, Rohit swings and does not make contact. Mumbai boys Thakur and Deshpande are doing the job for CSK
back of a length and angling into the top of the stumps, chipped into the leg side
slower short ball outside off, David does not pick the variation. Slogs early and misses

Mumbai boy Deshpande takes out the MI captain. Holes out to Jadeja at deep midwicket. Shoulder-high short ball just outside off. Hardik can't get on top of it and finds one of the world's best fielders in the deep
short and into the pitch, pulled away to deep backward square leg. Good defensive bowling from Deshpande this time
hoicked away to the left of Jadeja at deep midwicket. Just short of a length and angling into middle, Hardik whacks it away

excellent over from Thakur in tough conditions. . Just two runs off it. Back of a length, into the pitch and away from the swinging arc once again. Hardik reaches for the ball and flat-bats it down to long-off
seems like another legcutter outside off. Hardik swishes but can't reach it
another slower cutter, hides it away from the swinging arc. Thrashed by Hardik to extra-cover
full and wide of off stump, another slower one, good defensive bowling from Thakur. Run down to deep third
another slower one outside off, Rohit swings way too early and loses his shape. He can't touch the ball
slowie outside off, flat-batted away to extra-cover
rides the bounce of this on-pace short ball outside off and glides it to point

Pathirana comes back and provides CSK with the breakthrough. Back of a length and into the pitch at 140kph. Slower ball at 140kph. Tilak swings early, loses his shape and plops it in the air. Thakur runs back and completes a terrific tumbling catch at mid-off. Pathirana is proving the point of difference in CSK's attack
slowie outside off, Tilak swings and ekes out an inside edge to short fine leg
whipped away to the left of a diving Mitchell at long-on. This is a mini-helicopter from Tilak. Hit between deep midwicket and wide long-on
short and Pathirana hides it away from the reach of Rohit. Heaved away to deep midwicket
mighty full and on off stump, driven to Thakur at mid-off
stabbed away through extra-cover
shortish and darted across off, forced to extra-cover on the back foot
fired full and into the pads as Tilak can't put it away
Tilak now shapes for the reverse-sweep and gets it away in the gap between point and short third. He uses the pace of Jadeja to his advantage
Rohit backs away, Jadeja darts another one into the pitch and in line with the stumps, dragged away to the left of Daz Mitchell at long-on
Rohit shapes for another reverse-sweep, but Jadeja hits the pitch and Rohit's upper body
Rohit backs away, meets a fullish one outside off and thrashes it away to the off-side sweeper
pitched-up delivery angling into off stump, Rohit maintains a stable base and launches it over the wide long-on boundary. Bam!
another slowie. Thakur takes it away from the reach of Tilak. Dragged from outside off to long-on

A direct hit at the non-striker's end. Is Rohit in trouble? Nope, he is in. Rohit had backed away and jabbed a yorker to extra-cover before scampering across to the other end. Gaikwad was the one who nailed the stumps
another legcutter, leaves Rohit outside off and beats his big swish
seems like a legcutter outside off, 111.6ks, swiped away to deep midwicket
whipped off the pads through midwicket
a bit too full and pushed across off stump, drilled away through the covers. Even Mitchell can't stop it from long-off
swiped away from a wide line outside off to deep midwicket, where Thakur does well to stop the ball
forced down to long-off

Deshpande drops Rohit. Pushed through on middle and leg, Rohit drops down to one knee and slog-sweeps it away in the air. Deshpande runs across, gets into an unstable side-on position at deep square leg and drops it. What's worse? He parries it over the boundary for six
This is inventive from Rohit. He doesn't do it too often. He reverse-sweeps from the stumps and scoops it up and over Fizz at short third
Rohit dashes out of the crease, meets a short ball outside off early and does not time it well enough. Heaved away to Mitchell at long-on
banged in short and outside off from round the stumps, flapped away through midwicket by Tilak
slower bouncer outside off, Rohit waits for the ball to arrive, then chops it away past the right of a diving Dhoni
punched straight back to Thakur, who seems to have got a hand onto the ball. Daz Mitchell stops it at long-on
belted away down the ground. Back of a length and angling across off stump, flat-batted away to the left of mid-off
good length and slanting into middle, bunted through midwicket
Rohit dares to sweep of the stumps and hits it to deep square leg
short and into the pitch, punched back to Jadeja once again
a touch slower and slanting into the top of off, defended back to Jadeja
short and attached with width outside off, Rohit latches onto it and cracks it away past point. He brings up his half-century off 30 balls
pushed through on middle and leg, played back to the right of Jadeja
tapped down to long-on on the back foot
lifter from Pathirana, rushes Tilak into a hook, weakly flapped away through midwicket
wide half-volley. Tilak stays leg-side of the ball and crunnnnnnnnnches it through extra-cover
very full and swinging into the pads, prodded back to the bowler off an inner edge

Mustafizur clings onto the catch at the deep-third boundary. Banged in short and wide of off, SKY uses the pace and bounce of Pathirana and upper-cuts it in the air. Mustafizur catches the ball with both hands at the edge of the boundary. But the momentum causes him to tumble. He scoops the ball up in the air, then jumps back into the field of play to catch it with both hands once again. Sensational effort at the boundary. Even coach Fleming has a smile on his face. A Sri Lankan and a Bangladeshi celebrate. Look at the PDA. SKY falls for a duck
very full and slings it wide of off, 151.2ks, away from the reach of SKY, as he swishes and misses
Pathirana strikes first ball for CSK on his return from injury! Kishan picks out Thakur at midwicket. Very full and on the pads, Kishan nails this but hits it straight to the infielder
pushed through flat and quick once again, but Rohit shuffles across off and manufactures a boundary. He sweeps it up and over backward square leg
Jadeja is a popgun firing darts, this strikes Rohit on the thigh pad
shortish and skidding across off at nearly 100ks, chopped away through point on the back foot this time
flat and fast, speared across off, as Kishan chops and misses
flighted on off, drifts in, and a hint of slow turn. Rohit opens the face and dinks it through point
dragged down on off stump, Kishan rocks back and hauls the ball away to deep midwicket
Thakur hits a heavy length and has Rohit playing the ball back to him
Rohit steps out and almost yorks himself! But he adjusts well, jabs his bat down, and squeezes it from the stumps. The ball rolls away between point and short third
back of a length and angling into off stump, blocked back to Thakur
good length and angling into off stump, defensively played back to the bowler
pumped away to the midwicket fence! Rohit backs away, manufactures swinging room. Thakur chases him and serves up a full-toss, which is dispatched over the leg side
Thakur catches Rohit in a tangle and draws a leading edge but it rolls away wide of point
even with the slower ball, when Kishan is seeing it as he is now, he can smash em. Bends his back away from the ball to make the room he wants to flay the short one through point. Brilliant cricket.
yorker on off stump from wide of the crease, KIshan finds cover
cuts him in half with that trademark delivery of his. Kishan thinks he has room outside off, seeing it pitch there, but the back of a length ball snakes in to hit him high on the thigh
defends the full length ball on off stump down to long-off

M-a-a-a-ssive. Wankhede is a small ground. And the square boundaries are barely 60m. But this pull shot has hit the roof of the stadium. This time, Rohit moved across his stumps, over to the off side. The last boundary, he made room on the leg side. He's toying with Mustafizur

charges out and doesn't get all of it, but with mid-off up, that's a safe shot. Rohit gets a boundary off the first ball of Mustafizur's over yet again. This is brilliant tactics. CSK's main threat being taken down
almost Surya's the ball from outside off stump to deep square leg, bending low because the bounce is low.
back of a length and outside off, defends
misfield by point moving to his left. Taking the pace off worked there. Kishan had to hold his shape and his power and timing weren't such a big threat.
glooooorious. This is classical cricket. Pitched up ball outside off. Met with a drive on the up. And the ball scorches the turf through cover. Can't fault the bowler for that.
hit me ball. Kishan is super strong at the square leg area and he feeds him that. Too short. On pace. Kishan can just pull on instinct.
takes the pace off which is why Rohit holds his shape and then only when the ball is right under his eyes, he flicks it away behind square on the leg side
pitches it up on middle, takes a little pace off, that means Rohit is reaching in front of his body to make contact, not the ideal position to be to get power. Only a single to deep fine
there we go. That's the Rohit pull. This time the old Wankhede bounce is back and Rohit just shifts his weight towards the length ball on off stump and swipes it away out of existence
keeps low and messes with Rohit's attempt to pull the ball from outside off stump. He's boss with that shot. So if he's mis-hitting them, something's off
continues to thrive by staying beside the ball, this time flaying the back of a length delivery outside off to deep point

stays nice and still this time and works the angle across him to perfection. A powerful pull shot, standing nice and tall at the crease to get on top of the bounce. The ball goes well in front of midwicket
good work from Deshpande, bowling a tight line on off stump. Kishan was winding up, but with no room - he might have hampered himself moving across his stumps slightly - he can only defend
pitches outside leg and pings the thigh pad of Rohit as he does not get hold of the leg-side flick
nudged away through square leg as Mustafizur floats another one on the pads
scythed away by Kishan but Dube, I think, makes a sprawling save at cover-point
shorter and slanting into the top of off from left-arm over, defended back to Mustafizur
shorter and outside off, run down to deep third
on a length and a bit too straight in line, picked away fine for a first-ball four off Mustafizur
Rohit rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and glides it away past the right of short third
Deshpande errs in line, pushes this into the pads of Rohit, who picks it away to the right of the leg umpire, beats deep square to his right as well
just short of a good length and outside off, Rohit responds with a jabbing punch to extra-cover
Deshpande drags his length back and gets it to skid into the top of off, Rohit plays it back to Deshpande
lovely ball from Deshpande! Nice and full, angling in and swinging away outside off. Beats the outside edge
starts off with a back of a length delivery that veers into middle, defended into the leg side on the back foot
